editorial:
Imagine being sent undercover into a world where everyone hates what you stand for. That is exactly where you find Greg, a cop who has to pretend to be an activist to spy on a group trying to stop a new dam from ruining a forest. While he is playing this part, he meets Myriam, a free spirit who truly believes in the cause. The movie feels like a mix of a tense spy mission and a sweet love story. You can really feel the pressure Greg is under because he is falling for a woman who would be heartbroken if she knew he was actually working for the people she is fighting.

The acting is great and makes the romance feel real, even though you know it is built on a lie. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you are looking for non-stop action. It is more about the feeling of guilt and the fear of getting caught. If you have a high-end setup, you should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the beautiful forest scenery, or maybe grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to keep the quality top-notch.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when Greg's true identity is revealed. The tension peaks as the activists realize they have a traitor in their midst. Myriam feels completely betrayed by the man she loved. In the end, the forest they fought for is lost to the dam project. Greg is left with the guilt of his lies and the loss of the only person who made him feel truly alive, leaving you with a sad, realistic finish.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about forbidden love and secret identities.
